svg.font-family: Segoe Print, Comic Sans MS, sans-serif
svg.text: Data model, the two job pipelines step by step, and the interfaces the web tier and workers share.
S3Media — SigV4 PUT, presigned GET 15 min
margin check: abort if no ack > 80% lease
finish: flush progress, then fenced write
Worker then: media.publish(files) → store.saveRecording(row) → finish(succeeded). Errors the user can fix throw RecordError (not retried).

Gateway modes: live (provider backends with fallback chains) · replay (cassette, element ids remapped) · scripted (offline ScriptedModel). Keys come from llm/credentials.ts scope, never process.env mutation.
Experiments repeat runs over seeds × faults × agents and report Wilson 95% intervals (lab/stats.ts); diff.ts compares a candidate against a baseline.
